referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The module includes the transportation of high-carbon ferrochromium to Europe. No secondary production considered, since secondary chromium is recycled to the foundries and has to be inventoried in the respective module, i. e. when casting the final rawmaterial in the stainless steel production.
